checks.detail: Screen labels are exactly Связать частоты and Связать магнитуды.
Only Spectrum and Persistence frequency participate; canonical Hz bridges selected units and linear/log axes; Spectrogram is excluded.
Only Spectrum magnitude dB and Persistence power dB participate; linear/hidden/noneligible fields are ignored.
Every applicable Area range reuses the existing Screen dual-handle component with active-pane scope and independent empty-auto endpoints.
Backend/provider authors Spectrogram and Persistence Jet output; Frontend pass-through does not override colorscale, add palette UI or change signal colors.
Existing body-portal menu anchors to clicked trigger, clamps/flips in app-shell/viewport at 8px, repositions on scroll/resize and restores focus on close.
Backend/provider authors only a new display as 2x2 with four empty named panes and first-pane focus; Frontend renders accepted layout/ids and existing/imported layouts remain unchanged.
One UI-only helper transfers into existing app/settings/Plotly/menu seams; no shell, Plotly host or accepted component geometry is replaced.
